description: List World Bank data sources (datasets), such as World Development Indicators and International Debt Statistics, one page at a time. Each id is the source_id that worldbank_search_indicators, worldbank_get_data, and worldbank_list_countries take.

per_page.description: Results per page (default: server default); sizes above 100 are served at that maximum, with a notice.

name: worldbank_list_sources

perPage.description: Page size served, after any reduction to the page maximum.

requestedPerPage.description: Page size asked for, or the server default; present only when perPage was reduced.

currentPage.description: Page number; past totalPages when the request ran off the end.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_timeout`: The World Bank Indicators API did not answer within the call's 50-second budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Explains an empty result, a page past the end, or a reduced page size.

title: List World Bank Data Sources
